results.title: CURRICULUM VITAE PROF. DR. SHAMSUL AZHAR BIN SHAH
results.content: Prof Shamsul Azhar Shah is a Professor of Epidemiology and Statistics and a Faculty member at the Department of Community Health, Faculty of Medicine, UKM. He obtained a bachelor`s medical degree (MD) and a master`s degree in public health with a subspecialty in epidemiology and statistics from UKM. With more than 200 publications in international and local journals, his research interests are non-communicable and infectious diseases. His special interests include but are not limited to mental health, cancer, paralympic sports, dengue, and tuberculosis. Prof Shamsul is a member of the Public Health Specialist Association of Malaysia (PPPKAM), International Epidemiological Association (IEA), and also the Malaysian Society for Environmental Epidemiology (MySEE).
